timeline.speaker: Peter
timeline.text: So the Well-Architected Framework. What is that, some kind of cloud blueprint?

timeline.speaker: Stewie
timeline.text: It's five pillars: reliability, security, cost optimization, operations, performance.

timeline.speaker: Peter
timeline.text: Five pillars? That's a lot of pillars. Do they all matter equally?

timeline.speaker: Stewie
timeline.text: They all matter, but there are trade-offs. Maximum reliability costs more.

timeline.speaker: Peter
timeline.text: So you can't have everything? There's no free lunch in the cloud?

timeline.speaker: Stewie
timeline.text: Welcome to architecture 101. You balance trade-offs based on business needs.

timeline.speaker: Peter
timeline.text: How do you know if your architecture is any good?

timeline.speaker: Stewie
timeline.text: Microsoft has a free assessment tool. It scores your workload on all five pillars.

timeline.speaker: Peter
timeline.text: And the security pillar? What does that cover?

timeline.speaker: Stewie
timeline.text: Defense-in-depth, Zero Trust principles, encryption, identity, and network security.

timeline.speaker: Peter
timeline.text: So it's basically the whole SC-100 exam in one pillar?

timeline.speaker: Stewie
timeline.text: Pretty much. The security pillar is the deepest of the five.
